title: Module 6: Thermal Regulation & Architecture
description: Analyze how termite mounds use thermal mass and pressure-driven airflow, then translate those principles into passive architectural cooling strategies.
learning_objectives: Explain how the stack effect contributes to passive thermal regulation.
Identify the roles of vent geometry, thermal mass, and distributed airflow in termite mounds.
Translate termite-inspired regulation principles into building or engineering design heuristics.
